correctness.rationale: Klein-four branched cover of P¹ has eight simple disjoint branch points, yielding genus 5. Prime-to-5 quotient Jacobian isogeny to elliptic E_a,E_b and genus-3 hyperelliptic D transfers 5-divisible ranks and a-number. Coefficients of (F_aF_b)^2 give diagonal Hasse–Witt factors a²+2,b²+2,h4±h2,h8 in an F5 change of basis, hence semilinear rank exactly count of nonzeros. Independent GF25 arithmetic over F5[t]/(t²−2) gives 506 admissible ordered pairs with ranks 3:20,4:180,5:306; 10 factor-pairs each have two points. Independently computed all ten saturated triple Groebner ideals <P_i,P_j,P_k,ZΔ−1>=1 over F5, proving no 3-fold vanishing over closure (not just F25). Source full pairwise saturation code inspected; geometric completeness follows ideal certificates.
